newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures end lower, off early highs.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures end lower, off early highs.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures reversed early moderate gains to end lower across the board on Friday, pressured by the yen's rebound against the dollar late in the day, traders said.
Prices ranged from unchanged to 1.0 yen per kg lower. Benchmark August was down 0.7 yen at 152.9 yen.

Activity was lacklustre, moving in line with the currency market, the traders said. "The participation by private investors was limited ahead of the spot expiry session next week. Easier prices in rubber producing countries also undermined sentiment," one trader said.
